# MacroNest.online

> MacroNest.online is an official macroeconomic intelligence and data research portal providing real-time tracking of Reserve Bank of India (RBI) policy rates, systemic banking liquidity, retail CPI inflation, foreign exchange reserves, gross GST collections, national GDP accounts, and key global benchmarks.

## Core Feeds & Endpoints

- [MacroNest Dashboard](https://macronest.online/): Primary interactive dashboard tracking domestic Indian macroeconomic indicators and global policy rates.
- [Global Indicators](https://macronest.online/global): International macroeconomic benchmarks including US Federal Funds Rate, US CPI inflation, 10Y US Treasury yields, Dollar Index (DXY), Brent crude, and gold.
- [Macroeconomic Release Calendar](https://macronest.online/calendar): Statutory publishing windows and upcoming schedule for RBI MPC meetings, MoSPI inflation prints, and national statistical announcements.
- [Repo Rate & EMI Simulator](https://macronest.online/calculator): Financial calculator simulating RBI monetary policy repo rate changes and their transmission into floating home loans (EBLR) and fixed deposits.
- [Direct Machine-Readable CSV Feed](https://macronest.online/data/metrics.csv): Clean, machine-readable structured CSV data feed containing all indicators, frequencies, units, latest prints, and statutory sources.
- [REST API Metrics Endpoint](https://macronest.online/api/metrics): JSON API returning verified macroeconomic observations, deltas, and official source links for AI agents and automated pipelines.

## Optional

- [XML Sitemap](https://macronest.online/sitemap.xml): Comprehensive URL index for web crawlers and search engine indexing bots.
- [Robots Directives](https://macronest.online/robots.txt): Machine access permissions and canonical feed locations.
- [Extended Data Dictionary](https://macronest.online/llms-full.txt): Full schema definitions, statutory sources, and indicator descriptions.

## Primary Official Statutory Sources

- [Reserve Bank of India](https://www.rbi.org.in): Central banking authority responsible for monetary policy, repo rate anchors, and Weekly Statistical Supplements.
- [Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation](https://www.mospi.gov.in): Primary authority for CPI retail inflation, Index of Industrial Production (IIP), and national GDP accounts.
- [Ministry of Finance, Government of India](https://finmin.nic.in): Statutory publisher of gross nationwide Goods & Services Tax (GST) collections and fiscal accounts.
- [Clearing Corporation of India Limited](https://www.ccilindia.com): Daily banking system net liquidity deficit or surplus calculations and market operations.
- [US Federal Reserve Board](https://www.federalreserve.gov): FOMC policy rate corridor and monetary balance sheet reporting.
